Operator log LIVE

    Hamilton quick reference · source & simulator limits

    Based on the Hamilton Digital Designs quick start sheet posted by Kitchener Minor Hockey ↗. This is an independent training aid. The sheet does not identify the model; the layout here is representative, not a photograph of a particular console.

    Starting: NEW GAME, CLEAR, then choose 1 for countdown (0 counts up). Confirm the period, minutes, seconds and hundredths with ENTER. Blank entry accepts the displayed value. SET TIMER edits time in separate fields; PERIOD moves to the next period setup.

    Scores: SCORE adds a goal. RECALL followed by the appropriate SCORE key opens a correction. Enter the total and confirm.

    Penalties: PENALTY, ENTER for normal, jersey number, ENTER, minutes, ENTER, seconds, ENTER. To release a penalty: RECALL, PENALTY, CLEAR, ENTER. Use +/− to select a line when there are two penalties.

    Intermission: INTERMISSION switches to a separate warm-up/break clock. GAME TIMER RUN/HOLD controls it. RECALL, INTERMISSION, 0, ENTER, 0, ENTER ends it. The game clock and penalties are preserved.

    Time of day: RECALL, TIME OF DAY displays local Toronto time. RECALL, SET TIMER returns to the game display.

    Team names: TEAM NAMES selects a team. Repeated digits cycle the letters printed on that simulator key; + advances a character, − moves back, ENTER saves. RECALL, TEAM NAMES restores the previous name. The simulator uses ABC on 1 through YZ on 9; confirm your physical keypad.

    Limits: Two penalty lines per team, no queue. ALT PEN previews delayed/misconduct entry with a held timer; activation and advanced penalty administration are not simulated. Use normal penalties for the drills. No automatic release after a goal. Practice defaults are configurable, not KMHA league rules. Console beeper, firmware settings, wiring and remote switches are omitted. Reloading resets the practice session.
